correctness.rationale: The characteristic-seven discriminant, Cartier–Manin matrix and stable-rank calculation are explicit. Four simple critical values give an A4 basis; Picard–Lefschetz transvections generate exactly all 51840 matrices of Sp4(F3) by exhaustive group closure. Distinct discriminant sections and the group order prime to seven permit tame specialization of this finite monodromy quotient. A standalone arithmetic checker verifies the necessary finite computations; it does not substitute for the geometric theorems.
